text: Scholarship Policy According to the strategy cooperation agreement between SICAS and University of Jinan, the students who get admission in this major through SICAS only have to pay CNY32,000/Year instead of CNY 44,000 /Year from the second year and the third year. The first year is not included. The scholarship will directly to reduce the tuition, not cash.
